current_ihs_program_observation: The current IHS Navajo Area page states that NAIHS has PL 93-638 contracts and compacts with tribal health corporations including Fort Defiance Indian Hospital/Tséhootsooí Medical Center to provide health services in the respective region.
regulatory_observation: 45 CFR 180.30(b)(2) deems hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program in compliance with Part 180.
statutory_definition_observation: 25 USC 1603(12) includes tribal health programs within Indian Health Programs; 25 USC 1603(25) defines a tribal health program as a tribe or tribal organization operating a program or facility funded by IHS through an ISDEAA contract or compact.
interpretation: The exact CMS CCN and facility name match the retained current facility identity proof, and IHS's current area page ties the named facility to a PL 93-638 contract/compact. The scope basis is Indian Health Program operation, not federal ownership. This is not an MRF availability or file-quality finding.
